title: The Special day for the family
subtitle: 节日庆典 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）
meta: 主题语境：节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）　|　核心词汇：special　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 special 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the headmaster wrote of ① a special day for the family in the record, and everybody in the school said at once that it was ② so special that nobody in the school would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the headmaster, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the special ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the special day for the family that anybody there had ever seen, or so the record for October 1979 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too special to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the special ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a special tool for the job, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as special as the tool for the job they had once had in the old school. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was special or not, and he said so.

By 1992 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was ⑦ something special, and nothing besides. The student from the next school called the whole plan ⑧ quite special; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the record kept the names of the special ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1995, in silence, she wrote of another special day for the family in the same record, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less special than anybody had expected. ⑩ The special tool for the job that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1997, was the one she could never quite name; the special ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 特殊（前置定语 a special day for the family：1985 年校长在学籍册里记下的那件特殊的日子）
B. adj. 特殊／特制（两处加强说法：so special that … 与 no less special than …）
C. adj. 特殊／特制（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 特殊（表语 too special to do：母亲觉得它太特殊，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 特制（前置定语 a special tool for the job：叔叔把整件事称作一桩特制的工具）
F. adj. 特制（同级比较 as special as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩为这活特制的工具相比）
G. adj. 特制（后置定语 something special：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 特制（受程度副词修饰 quite special：那位学生的评价）

items.q: a special day for the family
the special day for the family that
a special tool for the job
The special tool for the job that

answers.why: special 意为“特殊”，1985 年校长在学籍册里记下的是“一件特殊的日子”，此处作前置定语 a special day for the family。
special 意为“特殊”，此处用 so special that 结构，说它特殊到学堂里没人敢靠近。
special 意为“特殊”，学籍册上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的特殊全家特殊的日子，等于最高级的说法。
special 意为“特殊”，母亲认为这件东西“太特殊了，谁也用不上”，too special to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
special 意为“特制”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩特制的工具”，此处作前置定语 a special tool for the job。
special 意为“特制”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩为这活特制的工具一样特制”，同级比较用 as special as。
special 意为“特制”，学籍册上那半行字要的是“特制的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something special。
special 意为“特制”，邻学堂来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当特制”，quite 修饰原级 special。
special 意为“特制”，no less special than 表示“其特制不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之特制不亚于任何人的预料。
special 意为“特制”，母亲 1997 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的特制工具”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，校长在学籍册里记下了一件特殊的日子。（a special day for the family）
它特殊到学堂里没有一个人敢靠近。（so special that …）
母亲觉得它太特殊，谁也用不上。（too special to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩特制的工具。（a special tool for the job）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩为这活特制的工具一样特制。（as special as …）
到了 1992 年，学籍册上只剩半行字：要的是一件特制的东西。（something special）
answers: In 1985 the headmaster wrote of a special day for the family in the record.
It was so special that nobody in the school would go near it.
My mother thought it too special to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a special tool for the job.
He said nobody would call it as special as the tool for the job they had once had.
By 1992 the record asked for nothing but something special.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 special 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the headmaster wrote of a special day for the family in the record, and nobody forgot it.
It was the special day for the family that anybody there had ever seen, or so the record says.
My mother thought it too special to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a special tool for the job, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next school called the plan quite special, and everybody laughed.
The special ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
